summary: Computes a dot product between a reversed-order integer vector (first lane forced to 0) and a float vector using SSE multiply and horizontal shuffle-add. Returns the scalar result as a float promoted to the double return type.

local_names.v4: reordered integer lane source, first lane forced to 0

operations.description: Build v4 = [0, a1[2], a1[1], a1[0]]; reverses the three input integer components and forces the first lane to 0.
v2 = element-wise multiply of v4 by the float vector *a2 (SSE _mm_mul_ps).
Horizontal sum of the four v2 lanes using _mm_shuffle_ps extracts: v2[0] + v2[1] + v2[2] + v2[3].
Return the scalar sum, converted to float and promoted to the double return type.
